svg.text: Crescent Bay with the Sovereign beached along its curve in three pieces: the town in the stern, salvage yards on the midsection, the bow run up on the north shore.
Open hub: the wreck lines the bay, and Wreck Row, the corridor
through all three pieces, is the main street. Every district is
a short walk off it; inside is tight, the shore outside is open.
Train into the station in the stern
Port missions: Hulltown, yards, cliffs, beaches
Win the marker: the Gilded Parlor, stern saloon
Wreck Row to the launch stage on the bow
Board at the stern ladder: they are waiting
a bounty in the flooded bow

g.text: THE GILDED LILY · THE DECKS WE PLAY
true scale: 180 m long, 24 m across · bow to the right · Ned's crew are hostile from the first step aboard
UPPER DECKS · promenade, lifeboats, funnels, bridge
stern ladder: fight the aft deck

svg.text: BOARDING · NED'S CREW KNOW YOU: HOSTILE FROM THE FIRST STEP
THE LAUNCH RIDE OUT, AT DUSK
Ned's crew know who you are:
they line the aft rail and open
fire as the launch comes under
the stern. First fight: the aft
and the aft mast for cover.
Win it and the grand staircase
